hero.desc_sr: Sveobuhvatni alat za nadzor izgradnje. Zakonske faze, mobilni OCR skener računa, interaktivna mapa i praćenje budžeta na jednom mestu.
hero.desc_en: Comprehensive construction supervision tool. Statutory phases, mobile OCR receipt scanner, interactive map, and budget tracking in one place.
hero.note_sr: ✓ Setup u 1 minutu · ✓ 14 dana besplatno · ✓ Radi na terenu (PWA)
hero.note_en: ✓ 1-minute setup · ✓ 14 days free · ✓ Works on site (PWA)

features.desc_sr: Vođenje projekta od katastarske parcele do upotrebne dozvole uz automatsko ažuriranje faza i praćenje budžeta.
features.desc_en: Project management from cadastral plot to occupancy permit with automatic status tracking and budget monitoring.

features.desc_sr: Slikajte račun na terenu. Ugrađeni OCR automatski prepoznaje iznos, datum i PIB i popunjava formu.
features.desc_en: Snap a receipt on site. Built-in OCR automatically detects the amount, date, and Tax ID and fills the form.

features.desc_sr: Katalog izvođača i stovarišta sa geokodiranjem, precizno pinovanje parcele i navigacija na terenu.
features.desc_en: Contractor and supply yard directory with geocoding, precise plot pinning, and field navigation.

features.desc_sr: Prebacivanje između paralelnih kuća ili objekata u jednom kliku, uz potpuno izolovane podatke.
features.desc_en: Seamless switching between parallel houses or properties in a single click with completely isolated data.

faq.q_en: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a_sr: Ne. HouseBuilding je PWA (Progressive Web App). Instalirate ga direktno kroz browser na telefonu ili računaru, bez potrebe za App Store-om ili Google Play-om.
faq.a_en: No. HouseBuilding is a PWA (Progressive Web App). Install it directly through your browser on your phone or computer, without the need for an App Store or Google Play.

faq.q_en: How does the OCR scanner work?
faq.a_sr: Otvorite kameru na telefonu, uslikajte račun, i ugrađeni Tesseract OCR algoritam će automatski prepoznati iznos i datum i popuniti formu umesto vas.
faq.a_en: Open your phone's camera, snap a photo of the receipt, and the built-in Tesseract OCR algorithm will automatically detect the amount and date, filling out the form for you.

faq.q_sr: Da li mogu da vodim više gradilišta?
faq.q_en: Can I manage multiple construction sites?
faq.a_sr: Da, u zavisnosti od paketa. Pro i Preduzimač paketi nude mogućnost vođenja više paralelnih gradilišta sa potpuno izolovanim podacima.
faq.a_en: Yes, depending on the package. The Pro and Contractor packages offer the ability to manage multiple parallel sites with completely isolated data.
